redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/manifest.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: Wrote mf5, mf6, mf7 in tests/manifest.test.mjs before creating anything else and saw mf5 and mf6 fail (docs/release/marketplace-entry.json did not exist; 5 pass, 2 fail). Then created docs/release/marketplace-entry.json (name, github source with repo AleksandarBisevac/claude-archmap, description, category documentation, tags = plugin.json keywords including crud-matrix, homepage, strict true) and aligned .claude-plugin/marketplace.json's plugin description to the wording of README's first paragraph; the release entry description is the same string. mf5 checks shape, description equality with the dev marketplace, no pre-release in either; mf6 checks tags equal keywords in order and include crud-matrix; mf7 proves the comparison helpers (sameText, sameList, preRelease) reject a differing description, a differing tag list and a pre-release note. After: node --test tests/manifest.test.mjs 7 pass 0 fail; node --test 456 pass 0 fail. Dependants: docs/architecture model and archmap.html and docs/design.md only name marketplace.json by path; grep for the old description text finds no other file, so they are still correct. tests/manifest.test.mjs and the new entry have no dependants. The claude-plugins repository was not touched.
outcome.descriptive: Release-ready marketplace entry for 1.0.0 prepared in docs/release, dev marketplace description aligned, and tests that fail on description drift, tag drift or a pre-release note.
